product.name: Monolith by Monoprice THX-275IW THX Certified Select 3-Way In-Wall Speaker
product.description: Monolith™ by Monoprice™THX‑275IW THX® Certified Select In‑Wall SpeakerThe Monolith™ THX-275IW THX® Certified Select 3-Way In-Wall Speaker is a remarkable audio masterpiece designed to elevate your home theater experience to unprecedented levels. Meticulously engineered to deliver unparalleled accuracy and faithfully reproduce every intricate nuance of the finest cinematic soundtracks and music, this speaker series is truly in a league of its own.With its prestigious THX Certification Select, this speaker guarantees optimal frequency response, dispersion, and minimal distortion, ensuring that the audio output is precisely as the skilled audio engineer intended. Prepare to be captivated by sound that is rich, vibrant, and true to life.At the heart of the THX-275IW lies a 6.5" woofer, carefully crafted to deliver deep, powerful bass that reverberates throughout your space, enveloping you in an immersive audio experience. Complementing the woofer is a 50mm silk dome midrange driver, which reproduces mid-frequency sounds with exceptional clarity and detail, lending a palpable presence to dialogue, vocals, and instruments. Additionally, a 25mm silk dome tweeter graces the speaker, providing crisp and sparkling high-frequency notes that add a new dimension to your listening pleasure.To ensure seamless integration and uncompromised performance, the THX-275IW boasts a sophisticated crossover network. This technological marvel harmonizes the different drivers, enabling them to work together synergistically, resulting in a cohesive and harmonious audio reproduction across the entire frequency spectrum.Installation is made effortless with the inclusion of heavy-duty dog legs. These sturdy and reliable mounting brackets securely hold the speaker in place, allowing for hassle-free in-wall placement. The sleek and discreet design seamlessly blends into your room, minimizing visual distractions and focusing the attention solely on the awe-inspiring audio emanating from within.In conclusion, the Monolith by Monoprice THX-275IW THX Certified Select 3-Way In-Wall Speaker is a pinnacle of audio engineering excellence. Immerse yourself in the true essence of home theater with unrivaled dynamics, exceptional detail, and immersive sound that will transport you to the heart of every cinematic adventure. Elevate your audio experience with this remarkable in-wall speaker, and redefine what it means to truly feel the power of sound.THX® Certified Select6.5" Woofer50mm Silk Dome Midrange25mm Silk Dome TweeterSophisticated Crossover NetworkHeavy‑Duty Dog Legs THX® CERTIFIED SELECTTested. Approved. Certified.THX® Engineers complete hundreds of different scientifically formulated tests to ensure the highest audio standards possible. Key tests in this program are as follows:Axial Frequency ResponseThis describes a loudspeaker's ability to reproduce audio accurately. Our test confirms the axial frequency response is balanced and flat.Vertical and Horizontal DispersionNot everyone gets the middle seat when watching a movie. So we test the off‑axis response to make sure it is smooth with no audible comb filtering, making every seat in the room the sweet spot.Output Versus DistortionThis test ensures the speaker can reach the high volumes necessary to achieve THX® Reference Level without creating audible distortion or artifacts. PREMIUM DRIVERSHigh Excursion Woofer.Silk Dome Midrange.Silk Dome Tweeter.Featuring carefully selected drivers that deliver a flat frequency response in the listening window, the THX‑275IW features a 6.5" woofer, a 50mm silk dome midrange, and a 25mm silk dome tweeter. The silk dome midrange operates in the 550Hz~3.1kHz range, improving power handling, lowering distortion, and improving the polar response, which allows the speaker to achieve higher SPL. The 6.5" high excursion woofer features a long fiber pulp cone, NBR surround, and is designed with a shorting ring to keep distortion at a minimum. The combined driver design enables the speaker to reach sonic heights and deliver accurate sound for the best in home theater dynamics and detail. PRECISION CROSSOVER NETWORKThe THX® speaker series features carefully selected fourth order Linkwitz‑Riley crossover network acoustic filters. These sophisticated crossovers minimize sonic frequency overlap, reduce distortion, and are an excellent choice to minimize off axis response errors near the crossover frequency. EASY INSTALLThe heavy‑duty dog ear mounting system makes for a fast and problem free installation. The magnetically detachable grille is powder coated in white and can be painted to match any decor. TIMBRE MATCHSame Drivers. Same Soundscape.Monolith™ THX® Certified in‑wall and in‑room speakers utilize the same drivers and crossover components, allowing speakers to be mixed and matched to suit your room! Use in‑wall speakers for the rears and in‑room speakers for the LCR, and you will remain timbre matched across the Monolith THX family.   .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}5 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind this product with a 5 year replacement warranty, we offer a 45 day money back guarantee as well! This product features recyclable packaging that is simple to open, cost effective, with minimal waste, and fully protective as it travels to you.Service and SupportYou're never on your own with Monoprice products! We have a full team of friendly and knowledgeable technicians available to answer your questions, both before and after the sale. Contact our technical support team for questions about our products, troubleshooting, or even suggestions for products to fit your particular needs.
